run_f_gold: run f_gold to find and print K smallest elements from an array using O(1) extra space
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets comparing output with a filled function
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return the K smallest elements instead of printing them directly
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that maintains a K-element window scanning the rest of the array
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds K smallest elements in-place with O(1) extra space
